title: NA40001: Free Surface Hydrodynamics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Free surface conditions: linear and nonlinear. Theory of surface and internal
gravity waves: dispersion relation, linear and nonlinear wave theories, shallow
water wave theories, finite amplitude wave theory, Numerical solution for
nonlinear waves, solution of problems with exact nonlinear free-surface
conditions: breaking wave computations, numerical wave tank. Wave diffraction,
refraction. Wave energy. Group velocity. Surface waves and interaction with
floating bodies: frequency-dependent added mass and damping, excitation force.
Forward speed free-surface flow problems: free-surface conditions with forward
speed. Neumann-Kelvin problems. Wave-resistance and ship-motion problems.
Nonlinear free-surface effects.
